decisions.reason: The editing-style change does not alter source selection; the same message's one-video source constraint is already represented separately.
Moment completeness and teaching value are independent content-selection requirements already established by separate clauses in the same message.
Prohibiting crazy effects and transitions does not revoke or change the existing requirement to use caption color.
The clean and simple editing standard does not change the existing requirement to select strong source moments.
The editing-style change provides no new duration range and leaves the existing 30-to-90-second requirement unchanged.
The editing-style decision does not change Lead Clipper responsibilities or status; the message's role-pathway language is consistent with the candidate's existing state.
The clean-editing modification does not change the qualification process, and the message's three-clip pass condition is already reflected in the candidate state.
The editing-style change does not alter the existing quota of 125 approved clips per month.
The source does not change the submission channel or the existing sample-clip review workflow.
